arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-10-30' AND date < '2019-10-31'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated on the day before the last day of data, 30 October 2019.
assumptions: The data ends on 2019-10-31, so I treated that as 'today' and 'yesterday' as 2019-10-30.
Counted every transaction, whether or not it has a fraud label.
Negative-amount transactions are included in the count.
